nav.conta_desc: data, password, second factor, sessions and invitations
nav.usuarios_desc: tenant members: create, edit, disable, reset password
nav.tokens_desc: service tokens with scope, restriction and validity
erro.sem_permissao: this screen requires the {privilegio} privilege, which your session does not have.
campo.login_ajuda: sign-in identifier; does not change later
campo.perfil_ajuda: the profile is the privilege ceiling; a custom role can only remove from it
login.esqueci: Forgot your password? Ask your tenant administrator.
login.inquilino_inexistente: tenant "{slug}" not found; check the address or enter the tenant
login.so_externo: this tenant signs in only through the organization login
login.muitas_tentativas: too many attempts; wait a minute
login.desafio_expirado: the challenge expired; sign in again with your password
conta.login_externo: this account signs in through the organization login; password and second factor belong to the provider
conta.pendencia_senha: your password is temporary; change it to continue.
conta.pendencia_2fa: the tenant requires a second factor; enable it to continue.
conta.apos_pendencia: available after resolving the account's pending item
conta.foto_ajuda: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, up to 1 MB; the image is cropped to a 200×200 frame
conta.idioma_ajuda: the screen translation does not yet follow this preference (item L7-10)
conta.visibilidade_inquilino: Visible to everyone in the tenant
senha.trocada: password changed; the other sessions were ended
senha.regra_base: at least {n} characters, with a letter and a number
senha.nao_atende_regra: the password does not meet the rule: {regra}
2fa.desligado_texto: no second factor: sign-in depends only on the password.
2fa.exigido_texto: the tenant requires a second factor; enable it with an authenticator app (TOTP).
2fa.ligado_texto: second factor on: sign-in asks for the password and the authenticator app code.
2fa.sem_codigos: no recovery codes remaining; generate new ones.
2fa.obrigatorio_inquilino: the tenant requires a second factor; it cannot be turned off.
2fa.instrucao: scan the QR code in the authenticator app or type the secret; then enter the generated code.
2fa.qr_rotulo: QR code of the TOTP secret
2fa.codigos_uma_vez: recovery codes: shown only once; keep them safe. Each is good for one sign-in.
usuarios.buscar: search by login, name or e-mail
usuarios.redefinir_confirma: generate a temporary password for {login}? Their sessions will be ended and they must change the password on the first access.
usuarios.desligar_2fa_confirma: turn off the second factor of {login}? Their sessions will be ended.
usuarios.apagar_confirma: delete {login}? This action cannot be undone.
usuarios.senha_temporaria_texto: temporary password for {login}; the user changes it on the first access.
usuarios.rodape: recommendation: keep two active administrators; the password lockout applies to administrators too
grupos.vazio_meus: you do not belong to any group
grupos.vazio_inquilino: no group visible from the tenant
grupo.atualizacao_ajuda: members edit items shared with the group; only at creation; requires entry by invitation or request
grupo.administrativo_ajuda: a member does not leave on their own
grupo.protegido_nao_apaga: protected group: turn off protection before deleting.
grupo.nao_sai_administrativo: administrative group: only the owner or a manager removes members.
grupo.membros_so_membros: the member list is visible only to active members.
grupo.sem_membro_para_dono: there is no other active member to receive the group.
grupo.apagar_confirma: delete group {nome}? Items shared with it stop being shared; the items remain.
grupo.convidar_buscar: search user by login or name
papeis.vazio: no custom role; the four profiles act as the default role
papeis.perfil_texto: the profile is the ceiling: a custom role can only contain privileges from this set.
papeis.privilegios_ajuda: the minimum profile is computed by the server; an administrative privilege requires the administrator profile; you can only grant what your session has
papeis.nao_tem_privilegio: your session does not have this privilege; you cannot grant it
tokens.rodape: the token is shown only once, at creation and renewal; revocation takes effect immediately
token.escopos_ajuda: a scope without :<uuid> covers every layer; tenant administration only for the administrator profile
token.renovar_confirma: renew {nome}? A new token is created with the same scopes; the old one remains valid for another 24 h.
token.revogar_confirma: revoke {nome}? Whoever uses it gets a 401 on the next call.
token.uma_vez: the token is shown only once; copy it now.
token.antigo_expira: the previous token remains valid until {quando}
token.referer_ajuda: one per line, like https://sig.exemplo.gov.br or https://*.exemplo.gov.br; empty = any origin
token.ip_ajuda: one per line, like 10.0.0.0/8 or 203.0.113.7; empty = any IP
erro_api.so_admin_altera_admin: only an administrator changes an administrator
nav.conteudo_desc: item catalog: layers, maps, apps, files; folders, search and sharing
catalogo.buscar: search by title, tags, summary or field:value
catalogo.busca_f_termos_faz: every word, accent-insensitive and stemmed (municipio matches Município and municípios)
catalogo.busca_f_operadores_faz: OR alternates, NOT or - excludes, parentheses group
catalogo.busca_f_exato_faz: equal value (owner login, type name, uuid); an invalid value is refused
catalogo.busca_f_data_faz: ISO 8601; * leaves the side open (modificado:[2026-08 TO *])
catalogo.busca_ex_criado: created in the 1st quarter and shared with the tenant
catalogo.busca_erro_sem_campo: colon without a field before it
catalogo.busca_erro_data: date in the format YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, or *
catalogo.aproximado: no exact result; showing results similar to "{q}"
catalogo.vazio: no item; create one in "New item" or ask a publisher for access
catalogo.vazio_filtro: no item matches this search, folder or filter
catalogo.selecao_limite: at most {max} items at a time; narrow the filter
catalogo.compartilhar_lote_ajuda: applies the level to everyone selected; groups and links are per item, in each one's panel
catalogo.nivel_sem_privilegio: your session does not have the privilege for this level
catalogo.publico_desligado: the tenant does not allow public items
catalogo.sem_grupos: you do not belong to any group you can share to
catalogo.grupo_sem_contribuicao: you do not contribute to this group
catalogo.erro_sem_contribuicao: you cannot contribute to the group {grupo}
catalogo.dependencias_texto: layers and data this item uses, with each one's level; check to apply the same level. Nothing is downgraded or upgraded without this mark.
catalogo.dependencia_sem_edicao: you do not edit this item; its owner decides its level
catalogo.links_texto: whoever has the link reads the item without signing in; revoking takes effect immediately
catalogo.link_uma_vez: the address is shown only once; copy it now.
catalogo.link_invalido: this link does not exist or was revoked ({codigo})
catalogo.tags_ajuda_editor: Enter or comma adds; up to {max}
catalogo.tags_nada: enter tags to add or a tag to rename
catalogo.f_bbox_ajuda: xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax in degrees (EPSG:4326)
catalogo.status_ajuda: authoritative is administrator-only and turns on protection; deprecated drops in search and shows the badge
catalogo.pasta_apagar_confirma: delete the folder {nome}? Only an empty folder can be deleted.
catalogo.pasta_nao_vazia: the folder has {itens} item(s) and {pastas} subfolder(s); move the content first
catalogo.upload_texto: the file uploads in parts and the server checks the content against the type; up to {max}
catalogo.arquivo_enviado: file {nome} uploaded; the item was created
catalogo.item_inexistente: item does not exist or is inaccessible
catalogo.abrir_em_futuro: opening in {destino} is delivered by the viewer product line; the catalog only records the item
catalogo.descricao_ajuda: Markdown; the server converts it and strips dangerous HTML
catalogo.item_oculto: item without access for your session
catalogo.erro_titulo: title is required, up to {max} characters
catalogo.erro_tag: each tag up to {max} characters, no comma
catalogo.erro_url: URL must start with http:// or https://
catalogo.erro_extent: extent is xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax in degrees, with xmin < xmax and ymin < ymax
catalogo.dados_texto: fields of type {tipo} (schema version {versao}); the server validates against the JSON Schema
catalogo.dados_erro_desconhecido: field not foreseen in the schema
catalogo.versao_conflito: someone else edited the item; reload before saving
catalogo.transferir_texto: transfer {n} item(s) to another tenant user; the pre-check lists what fails before running
catalogo.transferir_buscar: search the new owner by login or name
catalogo.transferir_adicionar_grupos: add the new owner to the groups the item is shared with
catalogo.transferir_parcial: Transfer only the ones without failure
catalogo.falha_novo_dono_sem_contribuica: new owner does not contribute to the group
catalogo.miniatura_ajuda: PNG, JPEG or GIF up to 10 MB; the server generates a 600×400 image and discards metadata
catalogo.miniatura_gerando: job {job} queued; the thumbnail appears when it finishes
catalogo.miniatura_demora: the job has not finished yet; check Tasks
catalogo.tipo_sem_gerador: this type does not generate a thumbnail by job; upload an image
catalogo.sem_permissao_compartilhar: your session does not share this item
catalogo.apagar_confirma: delete {titulo}? The item goes to the recycle bin for 30 days and can be restored with the same uuid.
catalogo.apagar_n_confirma: delete {n} item(s)? They go to the recycle bin for 30 days.
catalogo.apagar_obsoleto_dica: recommendation: mark an item others use as deprecated before deleting it
catalogo.apagar_dependentes: {n} item(s) depend on this one and would be deleted along with it
catalogo.dependentes_ocultos: {n} dependent(s) without access for your session; no cascade is possible
catalogo.apagar_protegido: protected item: turn off protection in the Settings tab before deleting
catalogo.lixeira_texto: items stay {dias} days in the recycle bin and are then purged
catalogo.esvaziar_nao_confirmado: confirmation text does not match; nothing was deleted
catalogo.expurgar_confirma: delete {titulo} now, with no way back?
catalogo.expurgar_n_confirma: delete {n} item(s) now, with no way back?
catalogo.versoes_texto: each edit records an immutable version; restoring creates a new version
catalogo.restaurar_versao_confirma: restore version {n}? A new version is created with its content.
nav.mapa_desc: local base map in MapLibre, layers and navigation
nav.conexoes_desc: connections to external services: health, history and published layers with provenance
mapa.erro_biblioteca: map library did not load (MapLibre or PMTiles missing)
nav.organizacao_desc: name, visual identity, default map, quotas and password/2FA policy of the tenant
org.logo_ajuda: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, up to 1 MB; the image is fit into a 300×300 frame
org.mapa_ajuda: center, zoom and base map a new map opens with in this tenant
org.seguranca_ajuda: the same policy /account already shows to every member when changing the password (tenant.config.auth)
org.senha_historico: do not repeat the last N passwords
org.senha_expira_dias: password expires in N days (0 = never)
org.exigir_2fa: require second factor (2FA) from every member
org.token_max_dias: maximum validity of a service token (days)
org.token_padrao_dias: default validity of a service token (days)
org.dominios_email: allowed e-mail domains (one per line; empty = any)
org.compartilhar_publico: allow public sharing of an item
org.erro_carregar: could not load the organization settings
smtp.ajuda: member invitation, password reset and notices go out through this server; without SMTP, these flows fall back to the manual path (temporary password shown to the admin)
smtp.origem_nenhum: no SMTP configured — manual path active
smtp.host_ajuda: empty removes this tenant's SMTP and falls back to the installation's (if any)
smtp.senha_trocar: new password (leave blank to keep it)
smtp.senha_ajuda: a password is already configured; fill in only to change it
smtp.erro_carregar: could not load the SMTP settings
convite.ajuda: creates the account when the invitee accepts; without SMTP configured, the link stays here to pass along manually
convite.criado_sem_smtp: invitation created; without SMTP, pass along the link below
aceitar_convite.concluido: Account created. You can sign in now.
aceitar_convite.sem_token: incomplete link: the invitation token is missing
aceitar_convite.invalido: this invitation does not exist or can no longer be used
aceitar_convite.usado: this invitation was already used or was canceled
redefinir_senha.solicitar_ajuda: enter the tenant and the registered e-mail; if an account exists with that e-mail, we will send a link
redefinir_senha.solicitado: If an account exists with that e-mail, a link was sent. Check your inbox.
redefinir_senha.concluido: Password changed. You can sign in now.
redefinir_senha.invalido: this link does not exist or can no longer be used
upload.dropzone: drag the file here or click to choose
upload.arquivo_pronto: the file is in storage and ready to become an import in /content
upload.tipo_desconhecido: could not recognize the file type; choose one from the list
construtor.publicar_confirma: publish version {n}? It becomes the version everyone sees who opens this item.
construtor.sem_versao_para_publicar: save at least once before publishing
construtor.largura_precisa_ser_inteiro: width must be a whole number from 1 to {max}
construtor.tela_vazia: drag an item from the palette, or use the Add button
construtor.selecione_um_item: select an item on the screen or in the structure
construtor.nao_pode_soltar_sobre_si: a node cannot be dropped onto itself
